label: Every word on the People & access screen

params.name: lede
params.default: Who has an account, which groups they are in, and which of the portal’s screens each may open. An account in no group sees what Catch All allows; a group member sees what their groups allow. A deny always beats an allow. This page, activity, visitors, memory, How to Use pages and email are yours alone as owner.

params.name: roles_note
params.default: Somebody who signs up themselves becomes {role}. Only an owner makes or removes another owner. The roles and what each may do in the builders are chips (people.roles, builder.can) — change them in Ops & chips.

params.name: remove_body
params.default: {who} loses access immediately, and every rule naming them goes too.

params.name: user_name_hint
params.default: Blank uses the first part of their email.

params.name: first_password_invite
params.default: Leave blank to email them an invitation instead — nobody has to send a password through a chat window.

params.name: first_password_no_email
params.default: Email is not set up, so give them a first password (at least {n} {n:character|characters}) and tell them to change it.

params.name: invited
params.default: Invitation emailed to {email}. It expires in 7 days.

params.name: must_choose
params.default: They must choose their own password the next time they sign in.

params.name: email_password
params.default: Email the new password to the person

params.name: email_password_none
params.default: Email is not set up on this portal, so share the password yourself.

params.name: signs_out
params.default: Setting a password signs them out on every device.

params.name: server_will_make
params.default: The server will make a {n}-character password.

params.name: can_sign_in_now
params.default: They can sign in with this password now.

params.name: were_signed_out
params.default: They were signed out on every device.

params.name: share_securely
params.default: Share this password securely with the person.

params.name: person_rules
params.default: Rules for this one person, on top of {groups}.

params.name: owner_only_note
params.default: and email (SMTP) are yours alone as the portal owner. No rule can open them to anyone else.

params.name: delete_group_body
params.default: Its rules go with it. Its members keep their accounts; a group that inherited from it inherits from its parent instead.

params.name: group_for_placeholder
params.default: People who check scripts before they ship

params.name: no_editors_group
params.default: No editors yet. Owners never need a group.

params.name: reject_body
params.default: They keep no access to {screen}. They can ask again.

params.name: no_requests_hint
params.default: When someone opens a screen a rule shut, they can ask for it. It lands here.

params.name: approved
params.default: Approved — they can open it now.

params.name: approved_still_shut
params.default: Approved, but it is still shut: {why} Remove that deny on Groups & rules.

params.name: owners_only
params.default: The portal's address, sign-up and mail settings belong to its owners.

params.name: this_portal_note
params.default: Links the portal emails or hands to other sites must be absolute. Set the address it answers on.

params.name: who_signs_up_note
params.default: Open by default: anyone with an email address makes their own account. With email set up below, a new account confirms its address first; without it, the account is live at once.

params.name: signup_open
params.default: Open — anyone with an email address

params.name: allowed_domains_hint
params.default: Used by "Only these email domains". Comma or space separated.

params.name: smtp_note
params.default: Without mail, sign-ups are not verified, Forgot password cannot send codes and there are no invitations — you hand over first passwords yourself and reset them from People.

params.name: gmail_1
params.default: Turn on 2-Step Verification for the Google account.

params.name: gmail_2
params.default: Make a 16-character App Password at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords. Your normal password is rejected.

params.name: gmail_4
params.default: Username and Send from are both the full Gmail address.

params.name: gmail_5
params.default: Press Send a test email. A refusal comes back as a sentence saying what to change.

params.name: saved_signup
params.default: Saved. The sign-in screen changes to match.

params.name: smtp_unreadable
params.default: Could not read the mail settings.

params.name: smtp_saved
params.default: Mail settings saved. Send a test to prove them.

params.name: smtp_sent
params.default: Sent to {to}. Not there in a minute? Check spam.

params.name: nothing_to_copy
params.default: Type or generate a password first.
params.label: nothing to copy

params.name: smtp_need
params.default: Save the email settings first, then send a test.
params.label: smtp need

params.name: ml_note
params.default: Every code and notice the portal tried to send, newest first, and what became of it. The codes themselves are never kept.

params.name: ml_h_sent
params.default: The mail server took it. Not in their inbox? In Gmail search in:anywhere from:{sender} - it may be in Spam, under a label, or moved by a filter or a mail-sorting app. Only the newest code works.

params.name: ml_h_throttled
params.default: {per_hour} codes an hour to one address, so this one was not sent. The next can go after {next}.

params.name: ml_h_no_account
params.default: Nobody here signs in as "{to}", so nothing was sent. Check the spelling, or look the person up in People.

params.name: ml_h_no_email
params.default: The account "{to}" has no email address, so no code can reach it. Add one, or set a password from People.

params.name: catch_all_note
params.default: What unassigned accounts and new sign-ups see - everyone who is in no group. Allow a screen here to open it to them; every group that inherits Catch All gets it too. A deny here wins for all of them. Built in: it can be renamed, never deleted.

params.name: inherits_note
params.default: Members get everything the parent allows, live, plus this group's own allows. A deny anywhere wins.

params.name: group_inherits
params.default: Inherits everything "{name}" allows, plus its own allows below.

params.name: group_inherits_none
params.default: Inherits nothing: its members see only what this group allows.

params.name: check_catch_all
params.default: In no group: Catch All decides what this person sees, with their own rules on top. A deny always wins.

params.name: check_groups
params.default: In {groups}: they see only what these groups (and the groups they inherit from) and their own rules allow. A deny always wins.

params.name: find_screen
params.default: Find a screen or a function

params.name: no_screen_hint
params.default: Try fewer letters, or another word from the screen’s name.

description_nl: The words of one screen. {placeholders} are filled on the page. A language overrides any of them with chip ui.access.<lang> (for example ui.access.hi).
